decisions.reason: As a burner component closely tied to the firm's core radiant-heating business, it is likely to remain in the portfolio unless demand proves too narrow.
The electric infrared panel heater supports electrification trends, but as a more standardised product it carries some risk of withdrawal if margins or sales disappoint.
The electric halogen infrared heater appears to be the most exposed to overlap and competitive pressure, so it has the highest discontinuation risk even though it is still worth keeping for now.
An industrial electric infrared hall heater fits the firm's machinery-oriented B2B profile well and is therefore likely to be retained.
The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater looks strategically important and already had a real operating deployment in 2023, making a near-term withdrawal unlikely.
